assertions: Every canonical question act produces a stable source-grounded question artifact.
Question artifacts retain exact spans, structural type, requested form, alternatives, surface presupposition markers, addressee state, domain, scope, confidence, and review.
Surface presupposition markers do not establish loadedness, unfairness, misleadingness, or answerability.
Every canonical answer act produces one answer-relation artifact.
Exact normalized relation targets take precedence over temporal candidates.
A single preceding question in bounded temporal context becomes probable and review-required, not identified.
Multiple preceding questions remain alternative targets.
An unsupported answer target remains unresolved.
An answer before an explicit question is not retrospectively linked without explicit target evidence.
Several answer utterances can jointly target one question.
Contracts support one answer targeting several questions when explicitly grounded.
Deferred, refused, inability, and presupposition-rejecting answer states remain distinct.
Qualification acts in the answer utterance remain linked to the answer relation.
No responsiveness, adequacy, completeness, or evasion score is produced.
Question-answer run and report artifacts are sealed, replayable, and reusable without provider reinvocation.
CLI operations build, validate, inspect, list questions, list answer relations, and list unresolved answers.
Schema export includes all five question-answer contracts.
limitations: Temporal proximity is a conservative candidate-link heuristic, not a semantic responsiveness judgment.
Addressees remain unresolved without explicit evidence.
The controlled fixtures qualify construction mechanics, not natural-conversation question or answer accuracy.
Selection and relation confidence remain uncalibrated.
